requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

1796-4399-4770--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Centaur Omenreader.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1796-4399-4770--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

3558-5006-6797-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-5006-6797-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

2829-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2829-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

4476-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4476-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
4476-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

3499-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3499-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3499-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

856-5776-6797-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2577-2921-7390.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, The Ghoul triggers, causing you to get two rad counters and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

814-1169-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-1169-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1651-2499-4426-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2499-4426-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2499-4426-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

3944-5220-5332-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

862-5220-5231-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1315-2511-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-2511-3234-3293.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat
1315-2511-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

3234-3293-5412-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5412-6797.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5412-6797.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1987-4045-4311-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

431-2557-3129-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-2557-3129-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

851-1680-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-3000-4506-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3000-4506-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

630-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
630-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
630-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

277-5411-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
277-5411-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

2781-4875-5686-6243.easyPrerequisites: any type other than "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
2781-4875-5686-6243.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Conspiracy. Choose any creature type except "Angel" as Conspiracy enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

914-3277-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3277-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Izzet Chronarch.
When Dockside Extortionist and Izzet Chronarch enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-3277-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

11-551-1283-5261.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast HIdden Strings by paying {2}, targeting any two applicable targets.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Narset's Reversal without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, returning Hidden Strings to your hand and creating a copy of it, targeting Isochron Scepter and Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the copy of Hidden Strings, untapping Isochron Scepter and Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Chromatic Orrery's second ability if you control a colored permanent and/or untap any other permanent(s) you control.

414-2744-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
414-2744-4613.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
When the Insect enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. This causes the Insect to gain Grist's abilities due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

1036-1185-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig and Wellwisher do not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Wellwisher.
There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1036-1185-3525.description:
Activate Wellwisher by tapping it, causing you to gain at least three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Wellwisher.
Repeat.

1636-1722-2034-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-1722-2034-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeating the process one additional time if you control at least eight lands.
Nadir Kraken triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first Nadir Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the second Nadir Kraken trigger, if applicable, choosing not to pay.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1548-2034-4034.notablePrerequisites:
Yore-Tiller Nephilim does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
1548-2034-4034.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Port Razer from your graveyard onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with Port Razer and Yore-Tiller Nephilim.
Port Razer triggers, untapping each creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Port Razer, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat each combat phase.

813-2103-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
813-2103-3742.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages that is tapped and attacking.
Scholar of the Ages enters, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

651-2200-4046.description:
Pay {0} to activate Outrider en-Kor, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 untill end of turn.
Repeat steps 1-2 untill Task Force has infinite toughness.
Tap Diamond Valley sacrificing Task Force, gaining life equal to its toughness.
